title: Eldritch Invocation
html:
In your study of occult lore, you have unearthed eldritch invocations, fragments of forbidden knowledge that imbue you with an abiding magical ability.

Eldritch Invocations are a  Warlock class feature first gained at Level 2. Invocations grant a variety of effects, ranging from powerful passive abilities to free uses of utility spells.

Once selected, Eldritch Invocations cannot be changed without resetting the character. Any Warlock can take any unlocked invocation; there are no subclass-specific invocations.

List of Eldritch Invocations

Invocation Level Description Grants
 Agonising Blast 2+ When you cast Eldritch Blast, add your Charisma modifier to the damage it deals, unless the modifier is negative.
  • Add your Charisma modifier to the damage of each beam of  Eldritch Blast (Passive Feature)
 Armour of Shadows 2+ You can cast Mage Armour on yourself at will, without expending a spell slot. Mage Armour increases your  Armour Class when you are not wearing armour. It will still function with Clothing-type armours.
  • Cast  Mage Armour at will
 Beast Speech 2+ You can cast Speak with Animals on yourself at will, without expending a spell slot.
  • Cast  Speak with Animals at will
 Beguiling Influence 2+ You invoke your patron's bewitching charm. You gain proficiency in the Deception and Persuasion skills.
  •  Deception proficiency
  •  Persuasion proficiency
 Book of Ancient Secrets 7+ You can inscribe magical rituals in your Book of Shadows. Gain Ray of Sickness, Chromatic Orb, and Silence spells.
  • Cast  Ray of Sickness,  Chromatic Orb, and  Silence, without expending a spell slot (maximum once per long rest for each spell)
  • This invocation can be chosen even if you did not take  Pact of the Tome
 Devil's Sight 2+ You can see normally in darkness, both magical and non-magical, to a distance of 24 m (80 ft).
 Dreadful Word 7+ You can cast Confusion with a Warlock spell slot.
  • Cast  Confusion as a Warlock spell
 Fiendish Vigour 2+ You can cast False Life on yourself at will as a 1st-level spell, without expending a spell slot. False Life grants you  7 temporary hit points.
  • Cast  False Life at will
 Lifedrinker 12 Your melee attacks deal additional ⁠⁠Necrotic damage equal to your Charisma modifier.
  • Add your Charisma modifier to the damage of your melee weapon attacks (Passive Feature)
 Mask of Many Faces 2+ You can cast Disguise Self on yourself at will, without expending a spell slot.
  • Cast  Disguise Self at will
 Minions of Chaos 9+ You can cast Conjure Elemental with a Warlock spell slot.
  • Cast  Conjure Elemental as a Warlock spell
 Mire the Mind 5+ You can cast Slow with a Warlock spell slot.
  • Cast  Slow as a Warlock spell
 One with Shadows 2+ When you are in an area of dim light or darkness, you can use your action to become  Invisible. Invisibility ends early if you move, attack, cast another spell, take an action, or take damage.
  • Cast  One with Shadows at will to become invisible (in dim light or darkness)
 Otherworldly Leap 9+ You can cast Enhance Leap at will, without expending a spell slot.
  • Learn  Enhance Leap. This is a ritual spell.
 Repelling Blast 2+ When you hit a creature with Eldritch Blast, you can push the creature up to 4.5 m (15 ft) away from you.
  • Push target creature(s) up to 4.5 m (15 ft) away with  Eldritch Blast (Toggleable Passive Feature)
  • At higher levels, each beam can knock back a target. However, if multiple beams are targeted on a single creature, the knockback will only occur once.
 Sign of Ill Omen 5+ You can cast Bestow Curse with a Warlock spell slot.
  • Cast  Bestow Curse as a Warlock spell
 Sculptor of Flesh 7+ You can cast Polymorph with a Warlock spell slot.
  • Cast  Polymorph as a Warlock spell
 Thief of Five Fates 2+ You can cast Bane using a Warlock spell slot once per long rest. Bane targets up to 3 creatures (+1 creature per spell slot level above 1st). They receive a 1d4 penalty to  Attack Rolls and  Saving Throws.
  • Cast  Bane as a Warlock spell (maximum once per long rest)
 Whispers of the Grave 9+ You can cast Speak with Dead at will, without expending a spell slot.
  • Cast  Speak with Dead at will
